title: Dark Blue Contrasting Clean
concept: Ohmie, a fictional snap-together robotics kit for kids aged 8–14: a near-black navy site held in a border-x framed shell with corner squares, whose cobalt gradient hero card shows a line-drawn robot you can switch between Explore, Follow line and Sleep, followed by spec strip, Frame/Rhythm/Signal kit cards, a six-week mission index and a cobalt pre-order band.
notes: Pure CSS + one small vanilla script (mode toggle, IntersectionObserver fade-ups, masked word reveal). Geist + Geist Mono from Google Fonts. No images or external libraries. Reduced motion disables all animation and shows content static.
